A1.justification: Both complete 53-page PDFs describe the same CHiQPM research. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support comparison of the equations, tables, figures, checklist, and appendices A–P without material gaps.

before.justification: V1 reports original classification, conformal prediction, interpretability, and ablation results on CUB-2011, Stanford Cars, and ImageNet-1K, including extensive appendix results.

after.justification: V2 retains those original empirical results, including the main benchmark comparisons, appendix ablations, and qualitative explanations.

M1.justification: The architecture, feature-selection constraints, training losses, and hierarchical prediction design are retained. Footnote 2 explicitly identifies the revised scoring equations as corrections to reflect the existing published code, rather than a change to the implemented method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same CUB-2011, Stanford Cars, and ImageNet-1K coverage for classification and set prediction. The appendix localization evaluations and qualitative test scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within the corresponding experiments: Tables 1 and 18–25 retain their architecture-specific baseline sets, and Table 2 retains THR, APS, and the s_sel and s_up score ablations.

E3.justification: The reported architectures, metrics, training settings, and calibration procedure remain unchanged, including reserving the first 10 test examples per class for calibration. The equation correction does not report a revised experimental protocol or rerun.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 and the appendices retain the same analyses of hierarchy density, feature-grounding loss, compactness, normalization/ReLU, dynamic versus static hierarchies, and localization. No ablation or qualitative case study is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both versions report means across five random seeds, with three for ImageNet-1K, and retain the same appendix standard deviations and their np.std definition in Appendix E. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Numerical and qualitative results are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 retains CHiQPM accuracies of 85.3, 91.9, and 75.3, and Table 2 retains a CUB set size of 1.73 at alpha = 0.1. No result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: Section 3.2.2 substantively corrects the score definitions: the argmin-based diversion index becomes an explicit shared-prefix count, s_sel is rewritten, and the limited-score summation changes from n_limit through n_wc to n_limit+1 through n_wc-1. These localized corrections appear in v2 Equations (11)–(13); subsequent equations merely renumber. No new proof or assumption is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about global and local interpretability, calibrated coherent set prediction, feature grounding, and competitive accuracy and efficiency.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and applicability qualifications are retained. Appendix L still discusses polysemanticity, QP scalability, ImageNet saliency limitations, the human-concept gap, exchangeability, and unconditional versus conditional coverage.

D1.justification: The new footnote explicitly links the corrected equations to the mathematical logic of the published code, clarifying implementation fidelity. Code-access information, hyperparameters, and resource details otherwise remain unchanged. Appendix A's disclosure of the factor-of-two loss implementation error and its limited reruns already appears in v1.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to QPM, interpretable models, and conformal prediction are unchanged. Reference-list pagination changes without adding or removing research.

P1.justification: V2 adds a short shared-prefix explanation and correction footnote, makes a small wording adjustment, and updates equation cross-references and the version stamp. The section order and substantive narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: The expanded equations and footnote cause limited layout reflow: Table 1 moves from page 8 to page 9, Figures 5 and 6 shift vertically, and the conclusion moves to page 11. No figure or table is added, removed, or substantively redesigned.

improvement.justification: V2 corrects the diversion indexing and summation definitions in a central prediction step and explicitly explains their relationship to the existing code. This makes the mathematical specification more reliable for reproduction. The gain is focused: empirical evidence, claims, and limitations remain unchanged, with no material loss of content.
